== Data Classification and Encoding Guide

The data classification is generally done by ice services, the WMO publication 574 is given as reference in file WMO574.pdf. As a guide for encoding some python scripts are given in directory “software” to convert shapefiles (e.G. Sigrid-3) into S-411.
